techmeme.headline: DeepSeek releases its new flagship models V4 Pro and V4 Flash in preview, saying V4 Pro trails the performance of state-of-the-art models by about 3 to 6 months
techmeme.context: DeepSeek rolled out preview versions of a new flagship artificial intelligence model a year after upending Silicon Valley

techmeme.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5, designed to handle complex tasks with minimal guidance; the model will be used to power the company's upcoming super app
techmeme.context: OpenAI is introducing an artificial intelligence model that's intended to be better at completing work without much direction

techmeme.headline: Meta plans to cut 10% of workers, or ~8,000 jobs, on May 20 and won't fill 6,000 open roles, in an effort to offset its AI spending and boost efficiency
techmeme.context: Meta Platforms Inc. plans to cut 10% of workers, roughly 8,000 employees, in an effort to boost efficiency and offset its heavy spending on artificial intelligence

sciencedaily.headline: AI Just Discovered New Physics in the Fourth State of Matter
sciencedaily.summary: Physicists have taken a major step toward using AI not just to analyze data, but to uncover entirely new laws of nature. By combining a specially designed neural network with precise 3D tracking of particles in a dusty plasma—a strange fourth state of matter—researchers have identified previously unknown patterns that could reshape our understanding of plasma physics.

bigthink.headline: The China factor in the great progression of the next 25 years
bigthink.relevance: Examina el progreso material y la revolución de tecnología limpia de China, y las consecuencias de que un estado autoritario dirija el futuro de la IA.
